limitations: The existing double-garage opening, garage envelope, utility doorway and house doorway remain.
The two 4.4 × 1.8 m concept cars are staggered to improve access and create useful storage beside the southern car. Actual household vehicles need checking before final joinery selection.
Door-use checks use 42-degree front-door openings and a 600 mm body. They do not claim every car door can open to 90 degrees in this retained garage.

The fourth outdoor bay is a 4.8 × 2.5 m compact-car space on the existing drive. Vehicle tracking and the pedestrian route are checked against the current model, subject to surveyed site and vehicle dimensions.
